entities.name: Charlot Magayi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Charlot Magayi is a Kenyan stove designer, climate activist and an Earthshot Prize winner in 2022. She and her company Mukuru Stoves were awarded a million pounds. Her success led her to be called "Queen of Africa" by William, Prince of Wales.
